target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft core library, Node and RawNode APIs, quorum/configuration/log machinery and Storage interface. Network transport, disk persistence and user state-machine/client completion are caller duties; MemoryStorage is an in-repository in-memory implementation.
protocol_contexts: Per-instance local ID, term, role, active ConfState and indexed term-tagged log
ownership: Node.run serializes core events; RawNode is thread-unsafe and requires caller serialization.
selection_injection: Storage, timer schedule, network delivery and application schedule are embedding choices.

behaviors.execution_owner: Serialized RawNode caller or node.run goroutine
behaviors.protocol_context: One local node ID and active leader knowledge
implementation_guards: RawNode rejects network local messages and responses from absent peers; Node also filters absent response senders.
Leader admission rejects removed self or transfer in progress; follower may forward; candidate drops.
external_effects: Propose return does not certify commitment. Caller observes committed entries and applies them; retries are caller policy.
Ready exports readStates and acceptReady clears that notification slice; actual state-machine read execution belongs to the embedding caller.
async_boundaries: Node channels serialize core processing; RawNode caller must provide serialization.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Delivers proposals to current role and exposes committed entries to application.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and active Progress map
behaviors.trigger: Admitted MsgProp or initial leader empty entry
implementation_guards: Own Progress must exist for proposals; no transfer in progress; payload quota; configuration proposals checked against pending applied position unless disabled.
writes: Assign term and indices; append unstable log; queue self MsgAppResp.
existing_protections: Commitment does not immediately follow appendEntry.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader/follower logs identified by index and entry term; RPC term
implementation_guards: Follower checks previous entry term; conflicts at committed indices panic; follower commit bounded by matching appended prefix.
important_branches: Previous index below committed returns committed index without new append.
Conflict rejection carries index/term hint; unavailable leader history uses snapshot.
external_effects: MsgApp response enters persistence queue, not direct network delivery.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.send plus RawNode Ready/Advance; storage performed by caller
behaviors.protocol_context: Response batch and local append-thread order
behaviors.trigger: Queued vote/append replies and unstable state
unknowns: Package doc permits same-batch message send concurrent with entry persistence while Ready.Messages requires after Entries; applicability of that relaxed policy needs separate investigation.
durable_effects: Core emits obligations to caller, not disk writes. Async caller must durably process append before delivering attached responses; sync caller persists before Messages and Advance.
async_boundaries: Remote and self responses may arrive after later core transitions.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Self/peer append acknowledgments are published under persistence duties before being used as replication support.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Vote replies, including self-votes, are held behind persistence before election tally.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and current incoming/outgoing voter sets
behaviors.trigger: Non-rejected MsgAppResp from tracked peer, or configuration switch
implementation_guards: Step term handling precedes leader consumer; missing peer ignored.
MaybeUpdate only increases Match; quorum evaluates voter IDs, not all tracked learners.
Commit advance requires current term match at quorum index.
writes: Update Match/Next and replication mode; advance commit.
external_effects: Broadcast new commit; release pending reads after current-term commit.
important_branches: Stale rejection indices do not regress Match; valid rejection retries with corrected Next.

behaviors.protocol_context: Candidate log identity and requested election term
implementation_guards: Repeat vote, no prior vote/no leader, or future pre-vote; candidate last log is up-to-date.
Lease guard can suppress higher-term requests except forced transfer.
writes: Real granted vote records Vote and resets election timer; pre-vote does not record a durable vote.
external_effects: Grant or rejection is queued through send.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current term, candidacy type and active voter sets
behaviors.trigger: Campaign or election timeout, then vote replies
implementation_guards: Campaign requires local nonlearner Progress, no pending snapshot, no unapplied committed configuration change.
Pre-vote increments no term; real campaign increments term and records self vote but counts self only via delayed response.
Tally deduplicates sender votes and requires both configured majorities; response type must match candidacy.
writes: Won pre-vote starts real campaign; won vote becomes leader, resets progress and appends current-term empty entry.
important_branches: Lost election becomes follower; same-term append/heartbeat/snapshot causes candidate to follow.

behaviors.protocol_context: Local term, role and leader identity
behaviors.trigger: Higher/lower-term messages, CheckQuorum, transfer, election changes
implementation_guards: Higher terms usually force follower; pre-vote/lease exceptions explicit.
Lower-term messages normally stop before role handling; stale storage snapshot completion is retained.
writes: reset clears peer Match, election tally, readOnly, pendingConfIndex and transfer state; Vote clears only when term changes; own Match initialized to last index.
important_branches: Transfer to nonlearner waits for Match at leader last index then sends TimeoutNow; proposal admission stops during transfer; timeout aborts transfer.
CheckQuorum steps down without active voting quorum when enabled.
Committed log and apply progress survive reset; pendingReadIndexMessages also survives, but heartbeat ack tracking does not.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Invalidates old peer replication support and read acknowledgments; does not roll back committed prefix.

behaviors.protocol_context: Applied configuration with incoming/outgoing voters, learners and staged learners
unknowns: Package guide and API differ on cancellation procedure; accepted change path is clear, cancellation policy needs an entry-specific contract.
implementation_guards: Simple change limits voter set difference to one; joint entry copies outgoing set; exit removes outgoing set and activates staged learners.
Changer validates progress and voter/learner consistency and nonempty incoming voters.
writes: Install active Config and copied Progress; retained nodes keep progress; new nodes start Match zero.
external_effects: Recompute leader commit under changed quorum; probe new peers; abort transfer to ineligible target; optional leader stepdown on removal.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changes which Match values qualify for commitment.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Changes voters used in elections and local eligibility.

behaviors.protocol_context: Restart storage state or snapshot index, term and ConfState
implementation_guards: Restart checks persisted commit within log bounds; starts follower using saved Term/Vote.
Snapshot must advance committed index, recipient must belong to snapshot config and receiver must be follower.
important_branches: Matching snapshot index/term fast-forwards commit without replacing log.
Nonmatching accepted snapshot resets unstable history and reconstructs configuration; append response is persistence-gated.
Bootstrap on empty storage creates term-one committed config entries and applies membership before caller persists/applies Ready.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reconstructs committed prefix and catches followers up; old election/peer progress is not restored.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Restores membership and saved term/vote; pending snapshot blocks campaigning.

behaviors.protocol_context: Acknowledgment emission term plus last entry index and entry term
implementation_guards: Response captures raft term separately from entry LogTerm; Step ignores old-term entry stabilization.
stableTo requires extant unstable entry and matching entry term before removing prefix.
writes: Advance unstable offset only on accepted identity; snapshot completion also advances applied position.
important_branches: New-term HardState-only append carries last unstable identity, allowing later completion to reconfirm prior writes without appending entries again.
Old-term snapshot completion remains valid because committed snapshot state is term-independent.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Protects the log view used for matching and commitment from prematurely relying on storage while conflicting writes remain in progress.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Async application is limited to stable committed entries.

behaviors.execution_owner: raftLog.nextCommittedEnts / RawNode acceptReady / raft.appliedTo; external state machine
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed prefix, applying and applied positions
behaviors.trigger: Ready output / storage apply response / Advance
implementation_guards: No committed entries issued while snapshot pending; quota limits outstanding apply batches.
Async mode bounds entries by stable offset; sync mode permits unstable entries subject to Ready processing duties.
writes: AcceptReady tracks applying; apply response/Advance updates applied and reduces quota; may propose auto-leave joint config.
durable_effects: State-machine writes are caller-owned. Async apply completion need not mean durable state-machine write.
important_branches: Node Advance API permits advancing while applying, provided successive Ready applications stay ordered; core applied accounting is not independent proof of user-visible application completion.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Application triggers caller configuration activation and automatic joint exit proposal.

behaviors.protocol_context: Read request context, captured commit index and current leader term
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex request and contextual heartbeat responses
unknowns: Whether version-qualified same-context retry wording permits a context to identify a later invocation requires focused source/version analysis.
implementation_guards: Nonsingleton leader waits for current-term committed entry.
Safe reads collect contextual acknowledgments and require active voting quorum; lease mode relies on CheckQuorum and timing assumptions.
important_branches: readOnly deduplicates contexts and releases queue prefix through acknowledged context.
Requests waiting for current-term commit survive reset and are reissued with current commit and fresh readOnly tracking; previously emitted ReadStates remain request-specific.
external_effects: Local ReadState or remote MsgReadIndexResp; caller must correlate request and reach application index before reading.

core_overview.rationale: Both principal paths and their persistence, membership, recovery and application connections have been read. Usable means a sourced starting map, not validation of the responsibilities or all variants.
open_details: Resolve synchronous same-batch send wording before using a relaxed caller persistence policy.
Read-only context reuse and version-qualified retry contract need separate investigation.
Storage backend crash behavior and application/client completion implementations are outside this core library boundary; in-repository MemoryStorage is not a disk durability implementation.
Detailed cancellation semantics and alternate API scheduling remain open; accepted membership activation and ordered application paths are mapped.

formation.explanation: RawNode.Propose or serialized Node loop enters the role-specific state machine. A leader admits entries, assigns term/index and appends locally; a follower forwards only with leader knowledge and enabled forwarding, while a candidate drops. Leader self support is queued, and follower MsgApp validates previous term and reconciles only an uncommitted suffix before queueing its response. send places append/vote responses behind persistence. Async MsgStorageAppend carries responses requiring ordered durable writes; synchronous Ready.Messages and Advance carry corresponding duties. Positive responses increase per-peer Match; configured majority order statistics (minimum of both groups for joint configuration) supply an index, and maybeCommit additionally matches the current term. Commit propagates through append and heartbeat; heartbeat commit is capped by recipient Match. Followers commit matching received prefixes and do not overwrite committed entries. Ready exposes committed entries, with async mode limited to stable local history and all modes pausing entries behind snapshots. The embedding state machine applies them in order, activates config entries, and correlates its own client completion. A successful proposal call has no commitment guarantee.

context.explanation: An election timeout or Campaign starts only for a locally eligible nonlearner without pending snapshot or unapplied committed configuration. Pre-vote leaves term/vote unchanged; real campaign increments term and queues its self vote until persistence. Voters check vote eligibility and last-log ordering; phase-specific replies are tallied once per sender over active voter sets. A won result establishes local leadership, resets replication tracking and appends an empty current-term entry. Higher-term traffic generally steps the node down, with explicit pre-vote and lease exceptions; lower-term traffic is rejected before normal role consumers. CheckQuorum can remove leadership after insufficient recent voter activity. Transfer pauses proposals, catches up an eligible transferee, sends TimeoutNow, and aborts after an election timeout. Membership activation changes voter sets and local promotability; removal stepdown is configurable. Restart rebuilds from storage HardState and ConfState as follower. Snapshot restore accepts a newer committed prefix with recipient membership, either fast-forwarding a matching log or installing snapshot and reconstructed configuration.

connection.explanation: Authority reset clears tally, peer Match, and heartbeat read acknowledgments but preserves log and committed/application positions; old uncommitted entries can be replaced only above committed. Current-term entry commitment requalifies retained earlier log history. Configuration application changes eligibility of retained Progress, while new members start Match zero and joint votes/commits require both majorities. Queued persistence responses retain original RPC context: stale network replies cannot enter normal consumers, and stale append-thread entry acknowledgments cannot release unstable entries even if entry identities recur. A new-term HardState-only append can reconfirm in-progress history; snapshot and application completions remain term-independent because they concern committed state. Pending reads waiting for the first current-term commit survive reset, then receive a new commit index and new heartbeat acknowledgments in safe mode; already collected readOnly acknowledgments do not survive. ReadState is only a request-specific application-read prerequisite. Committed configuration application also governs campaign eligibility, and automatic joint exit follows applied progress.

surfaces.reason: Package guide allows same-batch entry writes concurrent with message sends; Ready.Messages states after stable append. Preserve conflict for entry-specific caller policy investigation.
Version-qualified retry permission and context-keyed pending map need correspondence analysis before an oracle is selected.
Caller must restrict compaction to applied prefix; detailed backend retention/read interplay not mapped.
